concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: an OAK-THORN DRAGON, the SECOND stage of a two-stage Wood evolution line whose first stage is image 6: the oak-thorn dragon cub, in the same view and pose as image 1, standing on two legs with arms spread wide and claws out, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 head with face and thorn horns; 2 torso and neck with bark shoulder armour; 3 two arms with big thorn claws; 4 two legs with thorn claws; 5 two oak-leaf wings; 6 armoured tail; 7 two amber beads with oak-leaf trails;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 head with face and thorn horns: the grown-up oak-thorn dragon head: olive-green head and snout with a pale khaki chin, one big dark brown eye (one catchlight dot) exactly where the old eye is, a brow angled down, a confident grin with a small fang; the gold crests become big curved thorn horns of bark-brown oak wood in the same places and directions, the cheek fin a smaller wooden thorn, the goggle a flat honey-amber resin plate with a thin wooden rim over the viewer-right eye, the tall middle crest olive green with a bark-brown edge; no gold, no blue.
2 torso and neck with bark shoulder armour: an olive-green torso and neck with pale khaki belly scales; the collar becomes overlapping bark-brown armour plates across both shoulders; the pendant becomes a flat amber resin bead in a wooden setting; no red stripe, no blue crystal, no gold.
3 two arms with big thorn claws: olive-green arms in the same places; each forearm wears a bark-brown armour bracer with a bark-plate fin pointing up instead of the gold blade; the claws become big curved deep-crimson thorn claws hanging down, the same number and places; no gold, no blue.
4 two legs with thorn claws: olive-green legs in the same places with pale khaki inner sides and a small bark-brown knee plate on each shin; the foot claws become curved deep-crimson thorn claws; no gold.
5 two oak-leaf wings: big wings shaped like oak leaves: olive-green membrane with brown veins and a wavy lobed edge, a bark-brown wing bone along the top edge, the same sizes and directions; no teal.
6 armoured tail: an olive-green tail of the same curve with a row of bark-brown armour plates along its top edge and a wooden thorn tip.
7 two amber beads with oak-leaf trails: each orange streak becomes a thin trail of small olive-green and brown oak leaves following the same curve, and each gold ring becomes a small flat amber resin bead; no orange streak, no gold, no blue gem.

ATTITUDE: a proud dragon ready to slash: brow angled down, a confident grin with a fang, claws spread; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those. Image 6 is the approved first stage of this creature: keep its colours, face and drawing style; this stage is the same creature grown up.

COLOURS: olive-green skin, a pale khaki belly, bark-brown armour plates and wooden thorn horns, flat honey-amber resin, deep crimson thorn claws, olive oak-leaf wing membranes with brown veins, dark brown eyes. Few colours.

AVOID: bright fresh green skin, gold or yellow-gold horns, metal or claws, blue crystal or glass, gold bracelets set with blue gems, orange swoosh trails, gem shine, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
